name: thyra-onboarding-platform
description: Client registration, login and onboarding for Thyra. React (Vite) frontend on Supabase: Auth, PostgreSQL and an Edge Function API.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run api" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm install --prefix client --include=dev && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix client && deno lint --config supabase/functions/api/deno.json supabase/functions/api
